:::: {.hero}
# Practitioner Exchange

::: {.stand}
A facilitation retreat. Knowing your practice well is one thing. Holding a room
is another.
:::
::::

This three-to-four-day retreat gives around twelve wellness, bodymind and
movement practitioners a place to practise group facilitation with real peers.
Each participant leads a session in their own modality and then receives
structured, compassionate feedback. Along the way, you experience other
traditions from the inside and compare notes on what it takes to hold a group
well.

We take care of the frame: daily opening and closing practices, a short check-in
with you before you lead, and a safe container for reflection. That leaves you
free to try new things, take risks and grow as a facilitator.
